title: Hello Baby Round Wooden Baby Shower Book, Laser Engraved Natural Wood Newborn Guest Book, Rustic Circular Sign Notebook For Gender Reveal Maternity Photography Prop Nursery Decor Gift
body_html:
Unique Round Wooden Baby Shower Book Design: Adorned with elegant golden cursive "Hello Baby", delicate floral, leaf and heart laser engraving, distinctive circular shape stands out from ordinary rectangular guest books.
Premium Smooth Birch Wood Material: Polished burr-free wooden cover with eco-friendly natural texture, lightweight and sturdy, safe to use as newborn photography props with no harsh smell.
Perfect Baby Shower Guest Keepsake Book: The twine binding design lets guests write down warm blessings for the new baby, storing precious well wishes as a long-lasting newborn memory souvenir.
Multi-scene Versatile Decor & Prop: Works as baby shower table centerpiece, gender reveal backdrop decor, hospital newborn announcement photo prop, and cute nursery shelf ornament.
Ideal Sentimental Gift for Expecting Mothers: Exquisite rustic style matching all neutral nursery themes, a thoughtful heartfelt present for baby showers, maternity parties and newborn arrival celebrations.


Packaging: Kraft Paper Box with Raffia Filler
Package Size: 23×23×3CM, Weight: 371g
Carton Size: 60×25×47.5CM (36 sets per carton)
Carton Gross Weight: Approximately 15KG
Inner Pages: 20 sheets of 200gsm blank white cardstock (40 writing pages total)
